# SAMPLE Machine A Setup Note

> [!NOTE]
> Synthetic test fixture for multimodal pipeline validation. Not a real industrial procedure.

## Overview
Pre-operation checklist and calibration instructions for test unit Machine A (Model: SYNTH-001).

## 4-Step Setup Procedure
1. **Power Inspection**: Switch main power breaker to ON and verify the auxiliary indicator illuminates green.
2. **Coolant Level Verification**: Check reservoir fluid gauge and ensure fluid level is between 80% and 90%.
3. **Spindle Warmup**: Engage auxiliary spindle at 500 RPM for 3 minutes to circulate thermal lubrication.
4. **Safety Interlock Test**: Verify the emergency stop button disengages the drive servo immediately when pressed.
